description: The new capture caller passes a split result to a serializer that recognizes lists but not tuples.
trigger: Capture reaches save_tensor after successful forwarding, with Tensor.split returning a tuple of row tensors.
expected_behavior: Write individually named row tensors, or write the concatenated tensor for the newly supported dense-reader path.
actual_behavior: save_tensor falls through to save_file({'tensor': tuple}, filename), rather than constructing tensor.N entries. Successful serialization of reference tensors is therefore not established.
